PortableTools.Title: Phone files
PortableTools.Description: The storage a phone or camera shares over MTP, in a file browser, with copies to and from it — every copy read back and checked by SHA-256.
PortableTools.Status.NotRead: Open to read what it shares
PortableTools.Note.NoDevice: Windows has not made a portable device of it yet: unlock the phone and choose File transfer in its USB settings.
PortableTools.Note.OpenFailed: The device could not be opened: {0}
PortableTools.Note.NothingShared: The phone shares no storage yet: unlock it, and choose File transfer in its USB settings. It shows here as soon as it does.
